note: RIDEM state campground on the Point Judith peninsula in Narragansett, about a mile from the Block Island ferry. Areas 1 and 2 have full hookups (Area 1 is RV only); Area 4 has electric and water only, and DEM warns its power is not adequate for RV air conditioning in extreme heat (use may be restricted at peak times, heaters likewise in cool months); Area 3 is tents and canvas pop-ups only. Sites 071-073 at the west edge of Area 1 look over low shrubs to Point Judith Pond. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 2026 rates ($24/$45 Area 4, $28/$55 Areas 1-2), 30-amp hookups with sewer in Areas 1-2, 182 sites (147 RV-usable, all 25-50 ft, 129 pull-through), dump, RA booking; 2026 season opened April 10 (stored opens matches); no 2026 closing date posted, stored 10-30 not re-read.
